mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the arteries to the capillary bed was worthwhile because the branching picture connected distribution to exchange near tissue cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the lined artery and vein felt somewhat repetitive, although it established that both have an inner lining.

surprise.text: The vein needed a lining before its valves could be added. The compatibility feedback made that sequence clear.

arbitrary.text: Trying the valve folds with the venous wall seemed physically reasonable, so requiring the lining first initially felt somewhat arbitrary; the feedback explained the available next step.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, because building the route made the different vessel roles easier to connect, and I am curious how it will join the rest of the body.
